title: The Witness of the Marlowe Estate Anew
author: Oscar Iversen
blurb: Edmund Vasquez, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
